decisions.reason: Readable says what the handing over led to.

decisions.choice: siervo
decisions.reason: The Greek word can mean child or servant; here it is God's servant, as in Isaiah (meaning decisions m2, m3), so every level says "siervo".

decisions.choice: {{gender:antepasados|padres}}
decisions.reason: As in English: the fathers of the nation are the ancestors, men and women; "padres" is the traditional alternative. Literal keeps "padres", as the English Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: mtumishi
decisions.reason: The Greek word can mean child or servant; here it is God's servant, as in Isaiah (meaning decisions m2, m3), so every level says "mtumishi".

decisions.choice: mababu zetu, no gender span
decisions.reason: "Mababu" names the ancestors of the nation, so the English ancestors / fathers span has no Swahili counterpart; Literal keeps "baba zetu", as the English Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: "Đầy Tớ" capitalised for God's servant Jesus (also 3:26; 4:27, 4:30)
decisions.reason: The word is "pais", the servant of Isaiah (meaning decision), not "doulos", so it is "đầy tớ" at every level; the capital marks the title, as "Đấng Thánh" and "Đấng Công Chính" in 3:14.

decisions.choice: "tổ phụ" (L); "tổ tiên" (B, R) for "our fathers", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Luke (6:23). "tổ tiên" already means ancestors of both sexes, so the English setting has nothing to change here (also 3:25 and wherever Acts speaks of the fathers).

decisions.choice: "아브라함과 이삭과 야곱의 하나님", as the Korean Mark 12:26; "조상들" with no gender span; "종" for pais; "부인하다" (L), "거부하다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God's name to Moses at the bush (meaning decision) is worded as in the Korean Gospels. "조상" already means ancestors of both sexes (as in the Korean Luke 11:47), so the English span has nothing to change. The servant is God's servant of Isaiah (meaning decision), so "종".

decisions.choice: "አገልጋዩ" (his servant) for Jesus, here and in 3:26
alternatives: "ብላቴናው" (his child, his servant), the older church word
decisions.reason: The Greek word can mean child or servant; here it echoes the servant of God in Isaiah 52:13, as the meaning decisions say. "ብላቴና" is no longer current, and it reads first as a boy.

decisions.choice: {{gender:የቅድመ አያቶቻችን|የአባቶቻችን}} (B), with the case prefix inside each option; Literal keeps "አባቶቻችን" (our fathers)
decisions.reason: "ቅድመ አያቶች" (forebears) includes mothers and fathers, as the English "ancestors" does; "አባቶች" is the traditional word.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: capitalised pronouns as in the English setting
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; God and Jesus take honorific forms instead, at every level (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: "बापदादे" (L); "पूर्वज" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Hindi "पूर्वज" (forebears) already takes in men and women, so the English gender span on "ancestors" has nothing to change. Literal keeps the Greek "fathers" in the Hindi word "बापदादे".

decisions.choice: "सेवक"
decisions.reason: The Greek word for God's servant here (pais) is the servant of Isaiah (meaning decision m3), not a slave, so it is "सेवक" at every level, kept apart from "दास" for doulos.

decisions.choice: своего Слугу
decisions.reason: The Greek word pais means "servant" here, God's servant of Isaiah 52:13; "Слуга", as for pais elsewhere, written with a capital as a title. The reflexive "своего" takes no pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: предков, with "отцов" as the alternative
decisions.reason: "Fathers" means forebears, men and women; Literal keeps "отцов".

decisions.choice: "слуга" for pais, of Jesus as God's servant
decisions.reason: The brief keeps "слуга" for pais; here it is the servant of Isaiah 52:13. "Отрок" is Church Slavonic. The same in 3:26 and 4:27, 4:30.

decisions.choice: "先祖" with no gender span, where the English has "{{gender:ancestors|fathers}}"; Literal "父たち"
decisions.reason: Japanese "先祖" already takes in men and women, so it needs no span. The same holds for "sons of the prophets" in 3:25, where "子" is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: "しもべ" for God's servant Jesus, at every level
decisions.reason: The word can mean child or servant; with the echo of Isaiah's servant (m2, m3), "しもべ" fits. It is written in kana, as for the servants of God elsewhere.

source.text: ὑμεῖς δὲ τὸν ἅγιον καὶ δίκαιον ἠρνήσασθε καὶ ᾐτήσασθε ἄνδρα φονέα χαρισθῆναι ὑμῖν, τὸν δὲ ἀρχηγὸν τῆς ζωῆς ἀπεκτείνατε, ὃν ὁ θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν, οὗ ἡμεῖς μάρτυρές ἐσμεν.

records.literal_gloss: You but the Holy and Righteous [One] denied and asked a man a murderer to be granted to you, \v 15 the and Author of the life you killed, whom the God raised from [the] dead, of which we witnesses are.

en.L: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a man [who was] a murderer to be granted to you, \v 15 and you killed the Author of life, whom God raised from [the] dead, of which we are witnesses.
en.B: You turned your backs on the Holy and Righteous One and asked to have a murderer granted to you as a favor, \v 15 and you killed the Author of life. God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the dead; we are witnesses to that.
en.R: Jesus was holy, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did what was right, but you rejected {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. You asked Pilate to set a murderer free instead. \v 15 You killed the one who gives life! But God brought {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} back to life, and we saw {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. We are witnesses.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes negaron|vosotros negasteis}} al Santo y Justo, y {{plural_you:pidieron|pedisteis}} que se {{plural_you:les|os}} concediera un hombre [que era] asesino, \v 15 y {{plural_you:mataron|matasteis}} al Autor de la vida, a quien Dios resucitó de entre [los] muertos, de lo cual nosotros somos testigos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes renegaron|Vosotros renegasteis}} del Santo y Justo, y {{plural_you:pidieron|pedisteis}} como un favor que se {{plural_you:les|os}} soltara a un asesino, \v 15 y {{plural_you:mataron|matasteis}} al Autor de la vida. Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó de entre los muertos; de eso nosotros somos testigos.
es.R: Jesús era santo y hacía lo que era justo, pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:rechazaron|rechazasteis}}. Le {{plural_you:pidieron|pedisteis}} a Pilato que, en cambio, dejara libre a un asesino. \v 15 ¡{{plural_you:Mataron|Matasteis}} al que da la vida! Pero Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} volvió a la vida, y nosotros {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} vimos. Somos testigos.

fr.L: Mais vous, vous avez renié le Saint et le Juste, et vous avez demandé qu’un homme meurtrier vous soit accordé, \v 15 et vous avez tué l’Auteur de la vie, que Dieu a ressuscité d’entre les morts, ce dont nous sommes témoins.
fr.B: Vous avez tourné le dos au Saint et au Juste, et vous avez réclamé qu’on vous accorde la libération d’un meurtrier, \v 15 et vous avez tué l’Auteur de la vie. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité d’entre les morts ; nous en sommes témoins.
fr.R: Jésus était saint, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} faisait ce qui est juste, mais vous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avez rejeté. Vous avez plutôt demandé à Pilate de libérer un assassin. \v 15 Vous avez tué celui qui donne la vie ! Mais Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ramené à la vie, et nous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avons vu. Nous en sommes témoins.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi mlimkana yule Mtakatifu na Mwenye Haki, mkaomba mpewe mtu [aliyekuwa] muuaji, \v 15 mkamwua Mwanzilishi wa uzima, ambaye Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, jambo ambalo sisi ni mashahidi wake.
sw.B: Ninyi mlimkana yule Mtakatifu na Mwenye Haki, mkaomba mfanyiwe hisani ya kuachiliwa muuaji, \v 15 mkamwua Mwanzilishi wa uzima. Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu; sisi ni mashahidi wa jambo hilo.
sw.R: Yesu alikuwa mtakatifu, na alitenda yaliyo haki, lakini ninyi mlimkataa. Mlimwomba Pilato amwachilie muuaji badala {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \v 15 Mlimwua yule anayetoa uzima! Lakini Mungu alimfufua, nasi tulimwona. Sisi ni mashahidi.

vi.L: Nhưng anh em đã chối bỏ Đấng Thánh và Công Chính, lại xin tha cho anh em một kẻ giết người; \v 15 anh em đã giết Đấng Khởi Nguồn của sự sống, là Đấng Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến sống lại từ cõi chết; chúng tôi là nhân chứng về việc đó.
vi.B: Anh em đã chối bỏ Đấng Thánh và Công Chính, lại xin ân xá cho một kẻ sát nhân, \v 15 và anh em đã giết Đấng ban sự sống. Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ cõi chết, và chúng tôi là nhân chứng về việc ấy.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu là Đấng thánh và luôn làm điều đúng, nhưng anh em đã chối bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Thay vào đó, anh em lại xin Phi-lát thả một kẻ giết người. \v 15 Anh em đã giết Đấng ban sự sống! Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại, và chúng tôi đã thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chúng tôi là những nhân chứng.

ko.L: 그러나 여러분은 거룩하고 의로우신 분을 부인하고, 살인자인 사람을 여러분에게 놓아 달라고 요구했습니다. \v 15 그리고 여러분은 생명의 창시자를 죽였습니다. 그러나 하나님께서 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리셨습니다. 우리는 그 일의 증인입니다.
ko.B: 여러분은 거룩하고 의로우신 분을 거부하고, 살인자를 놓아 달라고 청했습니다. \v 15 그리고 생명의 주님을 죽였습니다. 그러나 하나님께서 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리셨습니다. 우리가 그 일의 증인입니다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 거룩하시고 언제나 옳은 일을 하셨습니다. 그러나 여러분은 예수를 거부했습니다. 그리고 빌라도에게 살인자를 대신 풀어 달라고 했습니다. \v 15 여러분은 생명을 주시는 분을 죽였습니다! 그러나 하나님께서는 예수를 다시 살리셨습니다. 우리는 살아나신 예수를 보았습니다. 우리가 그 증인입니다.

pt.L: Mas vocês negaram o Santo e Justo e pediram que lhes fosse concedido um homem [que era] assassino, \v 15 e mataram o Autor da vida, a quem Deus ressuscitou dentre [os] mortos, do que nós somos testemunhas.
pt.B: Vocês rejeitaram o Santo e Justo e pediram que lhes fosse concedido, como favor, um assassino, \v 15 e mataram o Autor da vida. Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitou dentre os mortos, e nós somos testemunhas disso.
pt.R: Jesus era santo e fazia o que era certo, mas vocês {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} rejeitaram. Em vez disso, pediram a Pilatos que soltasse um assassino. \v 15 Vocês mataram aquele que dá a vida! Mas Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} trouxe de volta à vida, e nós {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} vimos. Nós somos testemunhas.

am.L: እናንተ ግን ቅዱሱንና ጻድቁን ካዳችሁ፤ ነፍሰ ገዳይ የሆነ ሰው እንዲሰጣችሁም ለመናችሁ፤ \v 15 የሕይወትንም ምንጭ ገደላችሁት፤ እርሱንም እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን አስነሣው፤ ለዚህም እኛ ምስክሮች ነን።
am.B: ቅዱሱንና ጻድቁን ገፋችሁት፤ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ሰው በምሕረት እንዲሰጣችሁ ለመናችሁ፤ \v 15 የሕይወትንም ምንጭ ገደላችሁት። እግዚአብሔር ግን ከሙታን አስነሣው፤ ለዚህም እኛ ምስክሮች ነን።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ቅዱስ ነበረ፤ ትክክል የሆነውንም ያደርግ ነበር፤ እናንተ ግን ተቃወማችሁት። በእርሱ ፋንታ አንድ ነፍሰ ገዳይ እንዲፈታላችሁ ጲላጦስን ለመናችሁ። \v 15 ሕይወትን የሚሰጠውን ገደላችሁት! እግዚአብሔር ግን ከሞት አስነሣው፤ እኛም አይተነዋል። እኛ ምስክሮች ነን።

hi.L: पर आपने उस पवित्र और धर्मी का इनकार किया, और माँगा कि एक हत्यारा आपके लिए छोड़ दिया जाए, \v 15 और जीवन के कर्ता को मार डाला, जिन्हें परमेश्वर ने मरे हुओं में से जिलाया, जिसके हम गवाह हैं।
hi.B: आपने उस पवित्र और धर्मी से मुँह मोड़ लिया और माँगा कि आपकी ख़ातिर एक हत्यारे को छोड़ दिया जाए, \v 15 और आपने जीवन के दाता को मार डाला। पर परमेश्वर ने उन्हें मरे हुओं में से जिला उठाया; हम इसके गवाह हैं।
hi.R: यीशु पवित्र थे, और वे वही करते थे जो सही है, पर आपने उन्हें ठुकरा दिया। आपने पिलातुस से माँगा कि वह उनकी जगह एक हत्यारे को छोड़ दे। \v 15 आपने उन्हें मार डाला जो जीवन देते हैं! पर परमेश्वर ने उन्हें फिर से जीवित कर दिया, और हमने उन्हें देखा है। हम इसके गवाह हैं।

ru.L: Вы же от Святого и Праведного отреклись и просили, чтобы вам даровали человека-убийцу, \v 15 а Начальника жизни убили, которого Бог воскресил из мёртвых, чему мы свидетели.
ru.B: Вы отвергли Святого и Праведного и попросили, чтобы вам в виде милости отдали убийцу, \v 15 а Подателя жизни вы убили. Бог воскресил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} из мёртвых; мы свидетели этого.
ru.R: Иисус был святым и всегда поступал правильно, но вы отвергли {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. Вы попросили Пилата отпустить вместо {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} убийцу. \v 15 Вы убили того, кто даёт жизнь! Но Бог вернул {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} к жизни, и мы видели {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. Мы свидетели.

uk.L: А ви відреклися від Святого і Праведного і попросили, щоб вам дарували мужа-вбивцю, \v 15 а Провідника життя вбили, якого Бог підняв із мертвих, чого ми свідки.
uk.B: Ви відреклися від Святого і Праведного й попросили, щоб вам як ласку віддали вбивцю, \v 15 а Джерело життя ви вбили. Бог воскресив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} з мертвих; ми свідки цього.
uk.R: Ісус був святий, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} робив те, що правильно, але ви відкинули {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. Натомість ви попросили Пилата звільнити вбивцю. \v 15 Ви вбили того, хто дає життя! Але Бог повернув {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до життя, і ми бачили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. Ми свідки.

ja.L: あなたがたは、聖なる正しい方を拒み、人殺しの男を自分たちに赦してもらうよう求めました。\v 15 そして、命の創始者を殺しました。しかし神は、この方を死者の中から起こされました。わたしたちはそのことの証人です。
ja.B: あなたがたは聖なる正しい方を拒んで、人殺しを赦してもらうことを願い、\v 15 命の源である方を殺してしまいました。しかし神は、この方を死者の中から復活させられました。わたしたちはそのことの証人です。
ja.R: イエスは聖なる方で、正しいことをなさる方でした。それなのに、みなさんはイエスを退けました。そして、人殺しを代わりに放してくれるよう、ピラトに頼みました。\v 15 みなさんは、命を与える方を殺してしまったのです。しかし神は、イエスを死からよみがえらせられました。わたしたちは、よみがえられたイエスに会いました。わたしたちはその証人です。

decisions.choice: the Holy and Righteous One: titles of Jesus as God's servant
decisions.reason: Isaiah 53:11 calls the servant "the righteous one"; Acts uses the title again (7:52, 22:14). The centurion at the cross said, "Surely this man was righteous" (Luke 23:47).

decisions.choice: a murderer: Barabbas, set free in Jesus's place
decisions.reason: Luke 23:18-25 tells of Barabbas, jailed for rebellion and murder, released at the crowd's demand.

decisions.choice: the Author of life: the one from whom life comes, and who leads into it
decisions.reason: The word means a founder or originator, and also a leader who goes first. 5:31 and Hebrews 2:10, 12:2 use it of Jesus. Both senses fit; the contrast is plain either way: they killed the giver of life, and God raised him.

decisions.choice: of which: witnesses that God raised him
decisions.reason: As at 2:32.

decisions.choice: Jesus was holy, and he did what was right
decisions.reason: Readable turns the titles into plain statements.

decisions.choice: the one who gives life
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the main sense of the title, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: el Autor de la vida (L, B); el que da la vida (R)
decisions.reason: The title means the one from whom life comes and who leads others into it (meaning decision m3). "Autor" keeps the first sense, which Readable makes plain; "Príncipe" would suggest a royal title the word does not carry.

decisions.choice: Mwanzilishi wa uzima (L, B); yule anayetoa uzima (R)
decisions.reason: The title means the one from whom life comes and who leads others into it (meaning decision m3). "Mwanzilishi" (founder, the one who begins it) keeps both senses better than "Mkuu" (chief); Readable says plainly that he gives life.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Khởi Nguồn của sự sống" (L); "Đấng ban sự sống" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means the one from whom life comes and who leads into it (meaning decision). Literal keeps the picture of a source, Balanced and Readable say what he does.

decisions.choice: "생명의 창시자" (L); "생명의 주님" (B); "생명을 주시는 분" (R)
decisions.reason: The Author of life is the one from whom life comes and who leads into it (meaning decision). Literal keeps the idea of one who begins; Balanced uses the title of rule; Readable says what he does, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "የሕይወት ምንጭ" (the source of life, L, B); "ሕይወትን የሚሰጠው" (the one who gives life, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision gives both senses, the one from whom life comes and who leads into it; "ምንጭ" says the first plainly, where "ራስ" would read as a ruler.

decisions.choice: "ትክክል የሆነውን ያደርግ ነበር" (he did what was right, R) for "the Righteous One"; "ጻድቁ" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable says the title in plain words, as the English Readable does; Literal and Balanced keep the key term "ጻድቅ".

decisions.choice: "जीवन के कर्ता" (L); "जीवन के दाता" (B)
decisions.reason: The title means the one from whom life comes and who leads into it (meaning decision m3); Literal keeps the sense of origin, Balanced says the giver of life.

decisions.choice: Начальник жизни (L); Податель жизни (B)
decisions.reason: The title means the one from whom life comes and who leads into it; Literal keeps "leader", Balanced the main sense, the giver of life.

decisions.choice: "Провідника життя" (L), "Джерело життя" (B)
decisions.reason: archēgos is the one who leads into life and from whom it comes; Literal keeps the sense of leading, Balanced the source. "Начальник" now means a boss.

decisions.choice: "命の創始者" (L); "命の源である方" (B); "命を与える方" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means one from whom something begins and who leads the way (m3). Japanese has no single word for both; Literal keeps the sense of origin, and Balanced and Readable say that life comes from him. "命の君" is the wording of an older version.

source.text: καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ πίστει τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ τοῦτον ὃν θεωρεῖτε καὶ οἴδατε ἐστερέωσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡ πίστις ἡ δι’ αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὴν ὁλοκληρίαν ταύτην ἀπέναντι πάντων ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And on the faith of the name of him, this [man] whom you see and know made strong the name of him, and the faith the through him gave to him the complete soundness this before all of you.

en.L: And on the basis of faith in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, this man whom you see and know, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name has made strong; and the faith that [is] through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} has given him this complete health before all of you.
en.B: This man you see and know was made strong by the name of Jesus, through faith in that name. The faith that comes through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} has given the man perfect health here in front of you all.
en.R: This man was made strong by the name of Jesus, because of faith in that name. You see him and you know him. The faith that comes through Jesus has made him completely well, as you can all see.

es.L: Y por la fe en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, a este que {{plural_you:ustedes ven|vosotros veis}} y {{plural_you:conocen|conocéis}}, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre lo ha fortalecido; y la fe que [viene] por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le ha dado esta salud completa delante de todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: A este hombre que {{plural_you:ustedes ven|vosotros veis}} y {{plural_you:conocen|conocéis}}, el nombre de Jesús lo ha fortalecido por medio de la fe en ese nombre. La fe que viene por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le ha dado esta salud completa delante de todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Este hombre fue fortalecido por el nombre de Jesús, por la fe en ese nombre. {{plural_you:Ustedes lo ven y lo conocen|Vosotros lo veis y lo conocéis}}. La fe que viene por medio de Jesús lo ha sanado por completo, como todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} ver.

fr.L: Et sur la base de la foi en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, cet homme que vous voyez et connaissez, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom l’a affermi ; et la foi qui [vient] par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} lui a donné cette pleine santé devant vous tous.
fr.B: Cet homme que vous voyez et que vous connaissez, c’est le nom de Jésus qui l’a rendu fort, grâce à la foi en ce nom. La foi qui vient par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a rendu à cet homme une santé parfaite, ici, sous vos yeux à tous.
fr.R: C’est le nom de Jésus qui a rendu cet homme fort, grâce à la foi en ce nom. Vous le voyez et vous le connaissez. La foi qui vient par Jésus l’a complètement guéri, comme vous pouvez tous le voir.

sw.L: Na kwa imani katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, huyu mnayemwona na kumjua, jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} limemtia nguvu; na imani iliyo kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} imempa afya hii kamili mbele yenu nyote.
sw.B: Mtu huyu mnayemwona na kumjua amepewa nguvu na jina la Yesu, kwa njia ya imani katika jina hilo. Imani inayokuja kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} imempa afya kamili hapa mbele yenu nyote.
sw.R: Mtu huyu alipewa nguvu kwa jina la Yesu, kwa sababu ya imani katika jina hilo. Mnamwona na mnamjua. Imani inayokuja kupitia Yesu imemponya kabisa, kama ninyi nyote mnavyoona.

vi.L: Và nhờ đức tin vào danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chính danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho người mà anh em thấy và biết đây được vững mạnh; và đức tin đến qua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho người này sự lành mạnh hoàn toàn trước mặt tất cả anh em.
vi.B: Người mà anh em thấy và biết đây đã được làm cho vững mạnh bởi danh Đức Giê-xu, nhờ đức tin vào danh ấy. Đức tin đến từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cho người này được lành mạnh hoàn toàn ngay trước mặt tất cả anh em.
vi.R: Người này đã được làm cho mạnh mẽ bởi danh Đức Giê-xu, vì có đức tin vào danh ấy. Anh em thấy người này và biết người này. Đức tin đến từ Đức Giê-xu đã làm cho người này được lành hẳn, như tất cả anh em đều thấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그분의 이름을 믿는 믿음에 근거하여, 여러분이 보고 아는 이 사람을 그분의 이름이 강하게 하였습니다. 그리고 그분으로 말미암은 믿음이 여러분 모두 앞에서 그에게 이렇게 완전히 성하게 해 주었습니다.
ko.B: 여러분이 보고 알고 있는 이 사람이 힘을 얻은 것은 예수의 이름 때문이며, 그 이름을 믿는 믿음 때문입니다. 예수께서 주시는 믿음이, 여러분 모두가 보는 앞에서 이 사람을 완전히 낫게 했습니다.
ko.R: 이 사람이 힘을 얻은 것은 예수의 이름 때문입니다. 그 이름을 믿었기 때문입니다. 여러분은 이 사람을 보고 있고, 이 사람을 잘 압니다. 예수께서 주시는 믿음이 이 사람을 완전히 낫게 했습니다. 여러분 모두가 그것을 보고 있습니다.

pt.L: E, pela fé no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome, a este homem que vocês veem e conhecem, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome fortaleceu; e a fé que [vem] por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} lhe deu esta saúde perfeita diante de todos vocês.
pt.B: Este homem que vocês veem e conhecem foi fortalecido pelo nome de Jesus, por meio da fé nesse nome. A fé que vem por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} deu a este homem saúde perfeita aqui, diante de todos vocês.
pt.R: Este homem ficou forte pelo nome de Jesus, por causa da fé nesse nome. Vocês o veem e o conhecem. A fé que vem por meio de Jesus deixou este homem completamente curado, como todos vocês podem ver.

am.L: በስሙም በማመን፣ ይህን የምታዩትንና የምታውቁትን ሰው ስሙ አጸናው፤ በእርሱም በኩል ያለው እምነት በሁላችሁ ፊት ይህን ፍጹም ጤንነት ሰጠው።
am.B: ይህ የምታዩትና የምታውቁት ሰው በኢየሱስ ስም፣ በስሙም በማመን ጸና። በእርሱ በኩል የሚገኘው እምነት በሁላችሁ ፊት ይህን ሙሉ ጤንነት ሰጠው።
am.R: ይህ ሰው የበረታው በኢየሱስ ስም ነው፤ በስሙ በማመን ነው። ይህን ሰው ታዩታላችሁ፤ ታውቁታላችሁም። በኢየሱስ በኩል የሚመጣው እምነት ሙሉ በሙሉ ፈውሶታል፤ ይህንንም ሁላችሁ ታያላችሁ።

hi.L: और उनके नाम पर विश्वास के कारण, इस मनुष्य को, जिसे आप देखते और जानते हैं, उनके नाम ने बल दिया है; और उस विश्वास ने जो उनके द्वारा है, आप सबके सामने इसे यह पूरा स्वास्थ्य दिया है।
hi.B: यह आदमी, जिसे आप देखते और जानते हैं, यीशु के नाम से, उस नाम पर विश्वास के द्वारा, बलवान किया गया है। जो विश्वास उनके द्वारा आता है, उसी ने इस आदमी को आप सबके सामने पूरी तरह स्वस्थ कर दिया है।
hi.R: यीशु के नाम ने इस आदमी को बल दिया है, क्योंकि उस नाम पर विश्वास किया गया। आप इसे देखते हैं और इसे जानते हैं। जो विश्वास यीशु के द्वारा आता है, उसी ने इसे पूरी तरह ठीक कर दिया है, जैसा आप सब देख सकते हैं।

ru.L: И по вере во имя {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} этого, которого вы видите и знаете, укрепило имя {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, и вера, которая через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}, дала ему это полное исцеление перед всеми вами.
ru.B: Этого человека, которого вы видите и знаете, укрепило имя Иисуса через веру в это имя. Вера, которая приходит через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}, дала этому человеку полное здоровье у всех вас на глазах.
ru.R: Этот человек стал сильным благодаря имени Иисуса, потому что мы верим в это имя. Вы видите его и знаете его. Вера, которую даёт Иисус, сделала его совсем здоровым, и вы все это видите.

uk.L: І через віру в {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя цього [чоловіка], якого ви бачите й знаєте, зміцнило {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя; і віра, що [є] через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, дала йому це повне здоровʼя перед усіма вами.
uk.B: Цього чоловіка, якого ви бачите й знаєте, зміцнило імʼя Ісуса через віру в це імʼя. Віра, що походить від {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, дала цьому чоловікові повне здоровʼя тут, перед усіма вами.
uk.R: Цього чоловіка зміцнило імʼя Ісуса завдяки вірі в це імʼя. Ви бачите його і знаєте його. Віра, що приходить через Ісуса, зробила його зовсім здоровим, як ви всі бачите.

ja.L: そして、その名への信仰に基づいて、あなたがたが見て知っているこの人を、その名が強くしたのです。そして、この方による信仰が、あなたがた皆の前で、この人にこの完全な健やかさを与えたのです。
ja.B: あなたがたが見て知っているこの人を強くしたのは、イエスの名です。その名を信じる信仰によってです。イエスによる信仰が、あなたがた皆の前で、この人をこのように完全に健やかにしたのです。
ja.R: この人は、イエスの名によって強くされました。イエスの名を信じたからです。みなさんは、この人を見て、よく知っています。イエスから来る信仰が、この人をすっかり元気にしたのです。みなさんがみな見ているとおりです。

decisions.choice: a crowded sentence: the name of Jesus, with faith in it, healed the man
alternatives: the man was healed by faith alone
decisions.reason: Peter repeats "his name" and "faith" to make one point: Jesus himself did it, not the apostles (3:12).

decisions.choice: whose faith: the apostles', the man's, or both
decisions.reason: The sentence does not say. The man had asked only for money (3:3), so Peter's faith may be meant; but the man walked when told.

decisions.choice: the faith that is through him: faith that Jesus himself gives and calls out
decisions.reason: "Through him" says that the faith too came from Jesus.

decisions.choice: complete health: soundness in every part
decisions.reason: The word means wholeness; Isaiah 1:6 uses it in the Greek Old Testament of a body with no sound spot.

decisions.choice: the name of Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus, since the pronoun stands far from his name.

decisions.choice: afya kamili
decisions.reason: "Uzima" is kept for life itself in this translation, so the man's full soundness of body (meaning decision m4) is "afya".

decisions.choice: "đức tin" for faith at every level
decisions.reason: The key term of the Vietnamese Gospels and letters. The crowded Greek sentence (meaning decision) keeps its order at Literal and is untangled at Balanced.

decisions.choice: "그분의 이름" (L), "예수의 이름" (B, R); "그분으로 말미암은 믿음" (L), "예수께서 주시는 믿음" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Faith that Jesus himself gives and calls out (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say so, and name Jesus where the English does.

decisions.choice: потому что мы верим
decisions.reason: Whose faith is meant is open (meaning decision); Readable, needing a subject, names the apostles, who spoke the name.

source.text: Καὶ νῦν, ἀδελφοί, οἶδα ὅτι κατὰ ἄγνοιαν ἐπράξατε, ὥσπερ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν·

records.literal_gloss: And now, brothers, I know that in ignorance you acted, as also the rulers of you.

en.L: And now, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
en.B: Now, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I know you did not understand what you were doing, and neither did your rulers.
en.R: My {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I know that you and your leaders did not really know what you were doing.

es.L: Y ahora, hermanos, sé que por ignorancia {{plural_you:actuaron|actuasteis}}, como también {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} gobernantes.
es.B: Ahora bien, hermanos, sé que {{plural_you:ustedes no sabían|vosotros no sabíais}} lo que {{plural_you:hacían|hacíais}}, y tampoco lo sabían {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} gobernantes.
es.R: Hermanos míos, sé que ni {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ni {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} jefes {{plural_you:sabían|sabíais}} realmente lo que {{plural_you:hacían|hacíais}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je sais que vous avez agi par ignorance, comme aussi vos chefs.
fr.B: Maintenant, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je sais que vous ne compreniez pas ce que vous faisiez, et vos chefs non plus.
fr.R: Mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je sais que vous et vos chefs, vous ne saviez pas vraiment ce que vous faisiez.

sw.L: Na sasa, ndugu, najua kwamba mlitenda kwa kutojua, kama walivyofanya pia wakuu wenu.
sw.B: Basi sasa, ndugu, najua kwamba hamkuelewa mlichokuwa mkifanya, wala wakuu wenu hawakuelewa.
sw.R: Ndugu zangu, najua kwamba ninyi na viongozi wenu hamkujua hasa mlichokuwa mkifanya.

vi.L: Và bây giờ, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi biết anh em đã hành động vì không biết, các nhà lãnh đạo của anh em cũng vậy.
vi.B: Bây giờ, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi biết anh em đã làm điều đó vì không hiểu, và các nhà lãnh đạo của anh em cũng thế.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, tôi biết anh em và các nhà lãnh đạo của anh em đã không thật sự biết mình đang làm gì.

ko.L: 그런데 이제, {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나는 여러분이 여러분의 지도자들처럼 알지 못해서 그렇게 행한 것을 압니다.
ko.B: 그런데 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 여러분이 그런 일을 한 것은 무엇을 하는지 몰라서 그런 것이고, 여러분의 지도자들도 마찬가지였다는 것을 나는 압니다.
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 여러분과 여러분의 지도자들은 자기들이 무슨 일을 하는지 정말로 알지 못했습니다. 나는 그것을 압니다.

pt.L: E agora, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, eu sei que vocês agiram por ignorância, assim como também os governantes de vocês.
pt.B: Agora, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, eu sei que vocês não entendiam o que estavam fazendo, nem os líderes de vocês.
pt.R: Meus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, eu sei que vocês e os seus líderes não sabiam de verdade o que estavam fazendo.

am.L: አሁንም {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ እንደ አለቆቻችሁ ሁሉ እናንተም ባለማወቅ እንዳደረጋችሁት አውቃለሁ።
am.B: አሁንም {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ እናንተም ሆናችሁ አለቆቻችሁ የምታደርጉትን ሳታውቁ እንዳደረጋችሁት አውቃለሁ።
